phase_policies.applies_when: At the start of the game, both sides have limited information. Your own production and tech are uncertain, and the opponent's posture is similarly unclear.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first combat units or when you complete key tech structures. If the opponent shows early aggression, adjust your defense accordingly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech with flexible production, maintaining safety checks.
phase_policies.target: Maintain current development path with a focus on economy and technology. Keep production flexible to adapt to incoming information.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a specific tech or army composition without scouting; avoid neglecting defense while developing economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the early midgame, you have had time to develop your economy and tech. The opponent's posture is still uncertain, but you have some information.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's first combat units or when you complete key tech structures. If the opponent shows early aggression, adjust your defense accordingly.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue economy and tech development, with flexible production and ground defense if needed.
phase_policies.target: Maintain your current development path, focusing on economy and technology. Keep production flexible to adapt to incoming information. If the opponent shows a ground posture with Zealots, strengthen your ground army and continue developing economy and tech.
phase_policies.title: Early Midgame Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend economy without adequate defense; avoid neglecting scouting due to unknown composition.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the midgame, both sides have had time to develop. Your own posture remains uncertain, but the opponent's is also still unclear.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's main army composition or when you are ready to push out. If the opponent is passive, consider expanding or teching further.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech with defensive posture, adapting army composition to opponent's cues.
phase_policies.target: Continue to develop your economy and technology while maintaining a defensive posture. Keep your army composition flexible to respond to the opponent's eventual composition. If the opponent shows a ground posture, strengthen your ground army and consider increasing production and upgrades.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend economy without adequate defense; avoid neglecting air defense if the opponent has mixed forces.

phase_policies.applies_when: In the late midgame, both sides have had time to develop. Your own posture remains uncertain, but the opponent's is also still unclear.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you see the opponent's main army composition or when you are ready to push out. If the opponent is passive, consider expanding or teching further.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue economy and tech development with defensive posture, preparing for potential large-scale engagement.
phase_policies.target: Continue to develop your economy and technology while maintaining a defensive posture. Keep your army composition flexible to respond to the opponent's eventual composition. If the opponent has a ground posture with Zealots, Stalkers, and Immortals, strengthen your ground army and continue developing economy and tech.
phase_policies.title: Late Midgame Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overextend economy without adequate defense; avoid neglecting scouting due to unknown composition.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
